spans.s:
निभ [नि-भा-क] (At the end of
comp. only) Like, similar,
resembling; उदबुद्धमुग्धकनकाब्जनिभं वहंती

; so चंद्रनिभानना &c.
--भः, --भं
1 Appearance, light,
manifestation.
--2 Pretence, disguise,
pretext.
--3 A trick, fraud.

निभल् {c10c} U. To see, behold,
perceive, look at; निभाल्य भूयो
निजगौरिमाणं मा नाम मानं सहसैव यासीः

; or यन्मां न भामिनि निभालयसि
प्रभातनीलारविंदमदभांगिपदैः कटाक्षैः 3. 4.

निभूत a.
1 Quite frightened(अ
त्यंतभीत).
--2 Gone, past.

निभृत a.
1 Placed down,
deposited, lowered.
--2 Filled with, full
of; चिंतया निभृतः Bhāg.
--3
Concealed, hidden, out of sight,
unperceved, unobserved; निभृतो भूत्वा

,
Śi. 6. 20.
--4 Secret, covert; Śi. 13. 42.
--5 (a) Still, silent; निभृतद्विरेफं (
काननं)

. (b) Steady,
fixed, immovable, motionless;
Ś. 1. 8.
--6 Mild, gentle; अनिभृता
वायवः

.
--8 Firm, resolute.
--9
Lonely, solitary; निभृतनिकुंजगृहं गतया

.
--10 Shut, closed (as a door).
--11 True, faithful, firmly attached.
--तं Modesty, humility.
--तं ind.
1
Secretly, covertly, privatly,
unperceived; Ś. 3; Śi. 3. 74;

.
--3
Out of sight, in a corner.
--Comp.
--आत्मन् a. firm, resolute.
